Dendritic Integration in Layer Five

Renée Delacroix, Björn Åkesson

Abstract

We recorded from layer-five pyramidal neurons at 32°C and found that naïve estimates of dendritic gain overstated the effect by roughly a factor of two. Café-standard controls were applied throughout.
